application_credentials.description: MyDashLight signs in to Google with your own OAuth client. Follow the [setup instructions]({more_info_url}): set up the [sign-in screen]({oauth_consent_url}), then [create an OAuth client]({oauth_creds_url}) of type **Web application** and paste its client ID and secret here.

Signed in as {account}. MyDashLight plans rides for the activities on each kid's calendar. Events on a parent's busy calendars mean that parent can't drive then. Calendars you don't pick are never read.

The first parent is {mom} and the second is {dad}.

data_description.dad_calendars: Optional. Events marked Free, and events this parent declined, don't count.

data_description.mom_aliases: Names that mean this parent in event notes, such as a nickname or Mom.
data_description.dad_aliases: Names that mean this parent in event notes, such as Dad.
data_description.carpools: Other people who drive, such as the Parkers. Rides with them are shown but not planned.
data_description.home_address: Your street address, such as 12 Oak St. Events there, or with Home as the location, need no ride.
data_description.chore_days_ahead: How many days of chores, counting today, to keep on the kids' Google Tasks lists.

planner.name: Planner timing
planner.description: How the ride planner judges a plan. The defaults suit most families.

data_description.arrive_early: When an event has no Arrive by time, aim to get there at least this long before it starts.
data_description.arrive_early_max: The most a far-away event's margin grows to.
data_description.arrive_early_per: Minutes of driving from home that add one more minute of margin. With 6: 5 early when it's 5 minutes away, 10 when it's 30, 15 when it's an hour. 0 keeps every event at the least.
data_description.go_home_margin: Drive home between stops when that frees at least this much more time than waiting.
data_description.take_along_window: Suggest taking a kid along on an earlier drop-off only when it is at most this long before theirs.
data_description.waiting_after: Reaching a pick-up later than this after it ends counts as the kid waiting.
data_description.too_early: Getting there more than this long before the target is flagged.
data_description.tight_slack: Less spare time than this before the next stop is flagged.
data_description.no_address_travel: The drive time used for an event with no location whose notes still name a driver.

calendars.description:
Signed in as {account}. MyDashLight plans rides for the activities on each kid's calendar. Events on a parent's busy calendars mean that parent can't drive then. Calendars you don't pick are never read.

The first parent is {mom} and the second is {dad}.

data_description.kids: One calendar per kid, holding the activities that need rides.
data_description.mom_calendars: Optional. Events marked Free, and events this parent declined, don't count.

kid_name.description: The name shown on the ride board for the calendar {calendar}.

drive_times.title: Drive times from Google Routes
drive_times.description: With a Google Routes API key, MyDashLight looks up each trip's drive time with the usual traffic for that hour and weekday, and keeps it for 30 days. Without one, every drive counts as the Drive time with no address setting. A key is {key_state}.

data_description.routes_api_key: Leave empty to keep the key you have. The key is checked with one lookup before it's saved.
data_description.routes_daily_limit: Trips not looked up once this many are used for the day are estimated, then looked up the next day. 150 a day stays under 5,000 a month.
data_description.remove_routes_key: Forget the key and estimate every drive.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.description: Pick a notifier for each person who should get reminders on their phone, such as the phone's Home Assistant app. Before each drive, the driver gets a reminder saying where to go, and each kid in the car gets one saying when they leave or get picked up.

data.calendar_reminders: Also save drop-off reminders in Google Calendar
data.no_driver_alerts: Tell the parents about rides with no driver
data.no_driver_hours: Warn about rides with no driver this far ahead

data_description.mom_person: This parent's person in Home Assistant, located by their phone. When they drive, their reminder says when to leave from where they really are, and they're told if they haven't left by the arrive-early margin after leave time. Only the driver is told. Leave it empty to skip these checks.
data_description.dad_person: The same, for the second parent.
data_description.remind_before: Leave time is worked back from when the kid has to be there and the drive time, so the reminder moves with the plan.
data_description.calendar_reminders: Puts the reminder on the kid's event for each drive's first drop-off, so Google Calendar reminds the account MyDashLight signs in with. Google can't remind before a pick-up, since it only reminds before an event starts.
data_description.no_driver_alerts: Once for each ride that nobody is driving yet, sent to both parents' notifiers.
data_description.no_driver_hours: Hours before the ride. 6 by default: nobody plans much further out.

lunch.title: Lunch
lunch.description:
Each school day a kid hasn't picked Bring or Buy on the Lunch tab, they get their default. Picks are saved at the end of the notes of the day's "Lunch" all-day event on the kid's calendar, and days off are "No School" events.

**Menu feeds:** if a kid's school publishes its lunch menu as a calendar to subscribe to, paste its iCal address in their box (an address ending in .ics, or starting with webcal://, often under the calendar's ICAL or Subscribe button). MyDashLight reads it every few hours and adds each day's lunch to the kid's calendar as a "Lunch: …" all-day event. Menus changed by hand are left alone. Leave a box empty for none; kids at the same school can use the same address.

data_description.bring_by_default: Kids who bring lunch unless they pick Buy. Everyone else buys unless they pick Bring.

error.routes_key_rejected: Google turned down this key. Check that the Routes API is turned on for its project and that the key may use it.
error.routes_quota: Google says this key's quota for today is used up. Try again tomorrow, or raise the quota in Google Cloud.
error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach Google. Try again in a few minutes.
error.feed_not_web: That isn't a web address. It should start with https:// or webcal://.
error.feed_unreadable: Couldn't read a calendar feed at that address. Check that it opens a calendar file in a browser.

get_plan.name: Get ride plan
get_plan.description: Returns the planned rides for one or more days: each parent's route, the problems found and suggested fixes.

date.name: Date
date.description: The first day to return. Defaults to today.

days.name: Days
days.description: How many days to return, from 1 to 7.

set_ride.name: Set driver
set_ride.description: Sets who drops off or picks up for an event, and saves it in the event's notes.

event.name: Event
event.description: The event's id in the plan (an event's "id" in Get ride plan).

side.name: Ride
side.description: The drop-off, the pick-up, or both.

driver.name: Driver
driver.description: mom or dad (the first or second parent, or their name), none when no ride is needed, a carpool driver's name, or empty for nobody yet.

scope.name: Repeating events
scope.description: For a repeating event: change just this one, or every one.

set_stay.name: Set stay
set_stay.description: Sets whether the driver stays for the event instead of leaving and coming back.

event.name: Event
event.description: The event's id in the plan (an event's "id" in Get ride plan).

scope.name: Repeating events
scope.description: For a repeating event: change just this one, or every one.

set_attending.name: Set attending
set_attending.description: Marks whether the kid is going to an event. One they're not going to stays on the board, but needs no rides and doesn't clash with anything.

event.name: Event
event.description: The event's id in the plan (an event's "id" in Get ride plan).

attending.name: Attending
attending.description: Whether the kid is going. Going again also takes an old "NO" off the start of the title.

scope.name: Repeating events
scope.description: For a repeating event: change just this one, or every one.

set_arrive_by.name: Set arrive by
set_arrive_by.description: Sets when the kid needs to be there. Leave the time empty to go back to the usual margin before the start.

event.name: Event
event.description: The event's id in the plan (an event's "id" in Get ride plan).

time.name: Time
time.description: When to be there. Empty clears it.

scope.name: Repeating events
scope.description: For a repeating event: change just this one, or every one.

set_take_along.name: Set take-along
set_take_along.description: Sets who rides along: on a kid's event, the people after the driver on the Drop-off or Pick-up line (both when the driver stays); on a parent's own event, the kids or the other parent going too.

event.name: Event
event.description: The event's id in the plan (an event's "id" in Get ride plan).

kids.name: Kids
kids.description: Who rides along, by name: kids, or the other parent. Leave empty to take nobody along.

scope.name: Repeating events
scope.description: For a repeating event: change just this one, or every one.

side.name: Side
side.description: On a kid's event: the drop-off (default), the pick-up, or both. When the driver stays, it's always both.

apply_suggestion.name: Apply suggested fix
apply_suggestion.description: Makes the change a suggested fix in the plan describes.

suggestion.name: Suggestion
suggestion.description: The suggestion's id from Get ride plan.

get_chores.name: Get chores
get_chores.description: Returns the kids' chores the board shows, and the chore templates.

set_chore_done.name: Check off a chore
set_chore_done.description: Checks a chore off in Google Tasks and saves who did it, or opens it again.

chore.name: Chore
chore.description: The chore's id (a chore's "id" in Get chores).

done.name: Done
done.description: On to check it off, off to open it again.

by.name: Done by
by.description: Who did it: a kid or a parent, by name or id. Leave it out for the kid the chore is for.

save_chore_template.name: Save chore template
save_chore_template.description: Adds a chore template, or changes one. MyDashLight then fills the kids' lists from it.

template.name: Template
template.description: The template's id, to change one. Leave it out to add a new one.

repeats.name: Repeats
repeats.description: Daily, weekly, monthly, or school days (each weekday with no No School event on the kid's calendar). Use Every for every other week or quarterly.

title.name: Title
title.description: The chore, such as Vacuum the stairs.

icon.name: Icon
icon.description: An emoji shown with the chore.

details.name: Details
details.description: Shown when the chore is tapped.

who.name: Who
who.description: The kids who do it, by name. Each gets their own, unless they take turns.

take_turns.name: Take turns
take_turns.description: The kids in Who take turns, one each time, in order.

days.name: Days
days.description: Daily: which days, such as Mon-Fri (empty for every day). School days: which weekdays (empty for every school day). Weekly: a day such as Thu, or Any for sometime that week. Monthly: a date such as 15, a day such as 1st Sat, or Any.

every.name: Every
every.description: Every this many days, weeks or months: 1 is every time, 2 every other, and 3 months is quarterly.

starts.name: Starts
starts.description: The first day. Every and turns count from here. Today if left out.

ends.name: Ends
ends.description: The last day, for a seasonal chore.

points.name: Points
points.description: Points for doing it, saved for later.

paused.name: Paused
paused.description: Stop making this chore without removing it.

night_before.name: Night before
night_before.description: School days only: due the evening before each school day (Sunday for Monday) instead of that morning.

bring_only.name: Only on Bring lunch days
bring_only.description: School days only: made only on days the kid brings lunch, such as Pack lunch.

remove_chore_template.name: Remove chore template
remove_chore_template.description: Removes a chore template and the chores it made that aren't done or due yet. Done ones stay.

get_lunches.name: Get lunches
get_lunches.description: Returns each kid's lunch picks and days with no school, from the 1st of this month to the end of next month.

set_lunch.name: Set lunch
set_lunch.description: Saves a kid's Bring or Buy pick at the end of the notes of the day's "Lunch" all-day event on their calendar. Days with no school are skipped.

lunch.name: Lunch
lunch.description: Bring or Buy, or the kid's default to take the pick away.

set_lunch_menu.name: Set lunch menu
set_lunch_menu.description: Saves what the school serves on a day as a "Lunch: Pizza"-style all-day event on each kid's calendar. An empty menu removes it.

kids.name: Kids
kids.description: The kids who get this menu, by name.

menu.name: Menu
menu.description: The main dish, shown on the board. Leave empty to remove the day's menu.

details.name: Details
details.description: The rest of the menu, saved in the event's notes.

set_takes.name: Set errand time
set_takes.description: Makes a parent's own event an errand: it takes this many minutes, any time between its start and end, and the planner picks when. No minutes puts it back at its set time.

event.name: Event
event.description: The event's id in the plan (an event's "id" in Get ride plan).

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: How long the errand takes. Leave empty for an event at a set time.

scope.name: Repeating events
scope.description: For a repeating event: change just this one, or every one.
